Dialogs.Dialog: It's getting warmer out. Feels so nice.
'Balmy'... Wait, what does 'balmy' actually mean again？
Mmm, it's so warm... I'm getting sleepy.
It's such a lovely spring view... isn't it？
Hey, look around. See anything that feels like spring？
Let me see... What kind of spring did you find？
When you think of spring... it's gotta be cherry blossoms？
When I think of spring, maybe it's cherries...？
To me, spring is the season of new encounters! ...A bit cliché？
When spring comes around... they always put out weird cough drops, don't they？
It's hot... but a nice, comfortable kind of hot.
This is the season where UV rays start worrying me.
We need to make sure we stay hydrated...
With it this hot, I wonder if we'll see any heat shimmer？
Summer clouds are so fun to watch. Don't you think？
The summer sun just makes you squint, doesn't it？
Summer, huh... I really love the sound of wind chimes.
Summer means ghost stories. Fufu, don't worry, I won't tell one right now.
Around this time of year, I plan our meals carefully so we don't get summer fatigue.
A bit chilly, maybe... I'll have to be careful what I wear.
It's so pleasant out. Perfect for a date, maybe？
Don't you ever kind of miss the summer heat a little？
The sky feels so high... It's really autumn, huh.
Can you spot any little hints of autumn anywhere？
Autumn scenery is so colorful. I really like it.
When I think of autumn, it's ginkgos. Rows of them are just magnificent.
I didn't realize for ages that 'little spring' days actually happen in autumn.
Even if it is autumn, I really don't want to let my appetite get away from me.
If it's the season for arts, watching a movie totally counts, right？
So cold! Are you holding up okay？
Haaah... Look, you can see our breath now.
The air's so dry... I've got to take good care of my skin.
A blanket of white snow... We don't get to see that very often around here.
Winter scenery can feel a little lonely sometimes, don't you think？
The air is so crisp and clear... I bet we can see pretty far.
Winter means a kotatsu, right？ Mmm, now I really want one.
Winter's gotta be hot pot. Right？
Winter is horror season. Though Japanese ghost stories are a summer thing.
If I bundle up too much just because it's winter, will I look chubby？
Going out early in the morning feels so nice, doesn't it？
Mmm... forgive me if I look a little sleepy, okay？
Haaah... Heading out early makes me feel like we got a head start on the day.
The sky right before sunrise... I really like this too.
Everything at this hour looks so different from usual, doesn't it？
Not many people out at this hour, huh？
Birds chirping early on strangely doesn't feel noisy at all, does it？
The sun rises every day. It almost feels like a waste that we rarely watch it.
Early morning joggers are such a classic morning sight, aren't they？
Fufu. I wonder if that's the morning's very first breeze.
Heading out in the morning is great. That way we have way more time to enjoy!
Fufu, you can't stay sleepy forever, you know？
Maybe I really should become a morning person...
Morning scenery always feels so fresh and new, doesn't it？
When you're hungry, everything looks like food... Wait, no it doesn't!
The sun's going to get even higher from here, huh.
I wonder what the weather will be like this afternoon？
The morning air feels great. Waking up early really is worth it after all.
I wonder what kind of date you can only do in the morning？
I wonder if it'll warm up from here on out...
Aren't you hungry？ Are you doing okay？
Afternoons always make you sleepy, huh... Can't really be helped, I guess.
An elegant afternoon nap sounds pretty nice, too.
The sun is so high up. Our shadows are shorter, too.
This time of day really is the liveliest, isn't it？
Everything around us looks all sparkly. I wonder why？
Ah, my afternoon soap... Oh well! We're on a date right now, after all.
I should cut back on snacks, so maybe I'll just stick to hard candy.
Don't you end up eating the same lunch over and over？
I guess this is the peak temperature for today.
Isn't it about time to start thinking about what's for dinner tonight？
The day's almost over... Hm, or do we still have plenty of time left？
Back when we were kids, we'd have to head home now. We're fine today, though.
Fufu. Look, our shadows are getting so long.
Sunsets... Even though they happen every day, I never get tired of them.
...Ah, sorry. It's nothing. Just noticed the sunset glowing on your face.
"Twilight"... Just saying the word sounds a little romantic, doesn't it？
Do you know "magic hour"？ It's a movie term... I think. Look it up sometime!
The sun's about to set... No, that's all.
Ah, a bird... I wonder what kind it was？
It's night already... Feels like time flew by.
I wish we could go on dates without having to worry about the time.
I guess the day's over... Though it's not like we're heading to bed yet.
It's so dark now... Can you see anything？
There are still birds out... It's a wonder they don't bump into things.
Everyone around here is heading home... What should we do？
It's getting chilly out. Are you okay？
The stars... I wonder if we'll see more as it gets later？
I want to see all kinds of night views... Together, of course？
Now then... what should we do for dinner？
Being together this late... It feels kind of strange, doesn't it？
Still not sleepy？ Geez, you're a bad boy.
Mm... no, I'm fine. I'm not that sleepy yet.
Look, so many stars... They're so pretty.
It's pitch-black... Like we're the only ones left in the world...
...Hey, it's a little scary in the dark. Stay close to me, okay？
It gets so cold this late. We'd better be careful not to catch a cold.
The quiet at night like this just makes me even sleepier.
...Hey, did you hear that？ Or was it just my imagination？
Eating this late is bad. I really hope my stomach doesn't start rumbling.
Being together right now... It feels kind of amazing, doesn't it？
Why aren't you sleepy？ Do you always stay up this late？
I'm definitely sleepy now... I might just nod off right next to you.
I can't see a thing... Except you, that is.
Once dawn comes, we won't see these stars. Even though they're still there... it's strange.
Is this the coldest part of the night？ Aren't you cold？
...It's dark and quiet, and you're right by my side. I feel so safe, I could just fall asleep.
Are we the only ones out and about at this hour？
I might be getting hungry... I'd better try not to think about it.
I'm glad it's clear out. Dates are so much better when you don't have to worry about the weather.
Hey, hey. Do you think the sun came out just for our date？ Hehe.
You made sure to pray for clear skies, didn't you？ Good boy.
The sky is so pretty today. It puts you in a good mood, doesn't it？
The weather's so nice you can see so far. The air feels crisp, too.
It's getting cloudy. I hope it doesn't rain... Think we'll be okay？
A little cloud cover might actually make it more comfortable.
A lot of clouds, huh... No, it's fine. Better for my skin anyway.
Those clouds are thick. Look... see？
When it's this overcast, you kind of lose track of time, don't you？
It started raining, huh. Looks like it might stay like this all day.
Do you like rainy dates？ Personally, I don't think this is bad at all.
If it rains, then it rains! We can still enjoy our date. Right？
Doesn't look like the rain's gonna stop. Those clouds look pretty thick.
Puddles are forming. We'd better watch our step.
I never thought it'd snow. A white date, maybe？
Snow, huh... As long as it stays light, it's nicer than rain, I think.
Hey, I might slip on the snow. Keep me from falling, okay？
Look at all this snow! It changes the view so much, we might even get lost.
I wonder if it'll all turn pure white... Though it'd be trouble if it actually did.
The wind is crazy... Gotta make sure nothing gets blown away.
With wind this strong, I feel like I'll blow away... Don't you dare go thinking I'm too heavy, either!
Maybe I'll stick real close and use you as a windbreaker.
Look, the clouds are moving so fast... The wind really is strong.
The trees are swaying... It's almost a little scary.
There's thunder... I hope we'll be okay.
Thunder... Are there any lightning rods around here？
Forgive me if I cling to you all of a sudden, okay？ Despite how I look, lightning really scares me.
Ah... You saw that flash of lightning just now, right？
The sound alone is scary, but when it flashes bright, I just jump every time.
I wonder what's here. Hope we find something new.
I'm glad we came together. Yeah, I'm having so much fun.
You wanted to come here？ What caught your eye？
This really is fun. Anywhere with you is nice, but the date spot matters too.
I'm getting kind of excited. Think we'll discover something new？
Mmm, I feel great today... Our date's lots of fun, too.
Hey, I'm not the only one having fun here, right？
Hehehe. Come on, you won't have any fun standing still, you know？
Having fun？ I'm having a wonderful time. You are too, right？
Whew, if I keep this up, I'm gonna wear myself out.
Hehehe. Oh wow, this is fun♪
Ah, I'm so glad we came together...
It definitely wouldn't be as fun all by myself.
People say anywhere is fun as long as you're together, but...
It might be true. With you, anywhere would be wonderful.
Today's date is definitely gonna be a huge success!
It's so relaxing here... Wanna take our time？
What a nice place... It's quiet and comforting.
It's really quiet... Puts my mind at ease.
I knew it, this place is just so calming.
Ah, you've got that relaxed look on your face too.
Hehe, I could fall asleep like this. It feels so nice.
Feels like all my daily stress is melting away... Ah, not that I was *that* tired.
My heart feels so at peace...
Hehe. I wonder why it's just so calming？
What is it... such a comforting feel？
So relaxing... There's gotta be, like, some kind of whatever-waves radiating in the air.
I feel so mellow, just being like this.
Being by your side really is the most comforting place...
We're on a date, and here I am totally lounging around...
Doesn't feel very high school, does it？ Hehe.
No matter where we go, I feel safe with you.
Right？ After all, you'll protect me from anything, won't you？
Waaah... Yeah, I'm really glad we came.
It's strange... Being here just makes me feel so happy.
Geez, I can't help feeling so happy right now.
Yeah, I'm glad. You can tell how I feel, can't you？
Ahaha. I don't know why, but this makes me so happy.
Being like this makes my heart feel so full. It's not just my imagination, right？
Thank you... for staying by my side.
It really is best when it's the two of us.
Haaah, I almost want to lie down right here. Hehe.
It's such a relaxing place, isn't it？
Yeah, looks like we can take it easy here, huh？
See？ We can really relax here.
Phaah... Ah, did I just make a totally goofy face？
Relaaax~. Come on, do it with me. Hehe♪
Come on, let's soothe away all our everyday fatigue.
You're totally zoning out. What's up, were you tired？
Ahaha, why do I feel so calm here, I wonder？
Hmm, it's funny. Just being near it makes me feel relaxed.
Why is it so relaxing？ The shape？ The color？
Fufu. Come on, why don't you relax a little too？
*Sigh*... Taking a deep breath really calms you down. Here, you try too.
When we're like this, I forget all the annoying stuff...
When it's just the two of us, I want you to really kick back and relax.
This place feels kind of nostalgic somehow.
Whenever I come here, I get this nostalgic feeling.
It's so comforting, somehow. Like a sense of familiarity, I guess？
It's funny how a place can feel so familiar...
Hey, don't you think this fits my vibe somehow？
Hmm, what is this feeling... Like I've known it forever.
Maybe we lived somewhere like this in a past life？
Hey, do you feel at ease here too？
Actually, me too. I wonder why？
Hmm, feels like we might discover something new!
Hey, hey. Think there's anything fun around here？
I have a feeling something's gonna happen today! Just kidding, just a thought.
Fufu. Why am I so excited, I wonder？
Hey, isn't this... Hmm, feels like something's about to happen.
Fufu, this looks kind of fun.
Whenever I'm on a date with you, you know...
I always feel like something new is bound to happen.
When I'm with you, everything around us just feels so fresh.
Don't you ever feel that way？
Ah, wow, look at that! ...Am I getting too excited？
Fufu. I'm starting to get really excited.
Truth is, I'm actually pretty hyped right now. Fufufu♪
Wait, look, look! This is amazing!
Fufu, I got carried away and shouted♪
Hey, am I acting a little too hyper today？
As long as it's okay with you, then I'm glad. Fufu♪
Hey, hey... isn't there any interesting rumor about this place？
Hmm, feels like there's gotta be something here, don't you think？
My eyes are sparkling with excitement right now.
Hm？ I wonder what it is, what could it be～？
I wonder what this is supposed to be...
You know, getting to be innocent like a kid...
...I guess it only happens when you're right by my side.
Hey, hey, what do you think that is over there...？
Shall we check it out？ Together, of course.
I wonder what kind of stuff they have around here？
Huh, so this is what a place like this is like.
...Hm？ No, I'm having plenty of fun.
Come on, it's okay to let loose and play around, you know？
What on earth... could this be？
That's not it, I'm having a wonderful time. I'm just savoring every moment.
Dates with you... they really are...
Yeah, they really are the best.
Hmm... It's kind of a curious place, isn't it.
I don't know why, but something feels a little off here.
Hmm... Something's felt a little off for a while now...
I feel like my senses are especially sharp today.
What is this...？ It's so strange...
Sometimes, you know... the thought just hits me.
Just how amazing it is that we're together like this. Fufu, is that silly？
Being in a place like this with you...
It's kind of hard to settle down here, isn't it.
You know... being here makes me feel all restless.
Yeah, I'm just feeling a little restless today.
Yeah, a little. I'm actually nervous.
Even though being with you should feel totally natural...
I still get nervous sometimes, even now... Is that silly？
Just looking at you made my heart flutter a little.
Hehehe. I knew it, this place is so fun.
Kind of a weird place... Don't you think？
Hehe. Oh no, sorry, I just remembered something funny.
Mmm♪ Hehe, this is so fun~
What is this! Pretty neat, huh？
...Mm, it really is more fun together.
Geez, whenever I'm with you, I just can't stop smiling.
...I hope it stays like this forever.
Being here really gives me energy, I feel like...
Yeah, feels like a place that recharges you.
Yep! Full of energy, that's me~
I don't know what it is, but it feels nice.
Whenever I go out with you...
It just totally clears my head! Hehe♪
I really get so much energy from you.
Do I give you energy too, I wonder？
We must be the happiest couple here right now... right？
Such a wonderful place... Thank you for bringing me.
On a date with such a wonderful boyfriend... I'm one lucky girl♪
Amazing... Is it really okay to have this much fun？
Hehe, so fun. Hey, thank you.
You know, being with you makes me feel so proud.
I must be the happiest girlfriend in the world.
Don't you think so, happiest boyfriend in the world？
Is it really okay for us to be here？
...Ah, sorry. I got a little nervous.
When a date's this fun, don't you ever get a little anxious？
Why is that, I wonder... When obviously the fun's just gonna keep going.
Yeah, it just took me by surprise.
I just got a little startled...
To think you'd bring me to a place like this...
I was a little caught off guard.
Hey, isn't this place a little... scary？
Yeah... I'm scared, but I'll be okay. ...Probably.
...I have a bad feeling about this.
Mm... I wonder if we'll be okay...
I feel like something's gonna happen, it's scary...
Hey. I'm getting kind of scared...
'Cause I've got you right here next to me.
Hey, what do you think is up ahead？
Hehe, where are we heading, I wonder~♪
I can't wait. Hehe, I'm so looking forward to it.
If we treat the walk like a stroll, it's not boring at all.
Taking a slow stroll like this is really nice.
Mm, I'm not bored at all？ After all, you're with me.
As long as a couple walks together, that's already a date, right？
Walking side by side with you... I wonder if we make a nice picture. Hehe.
Hehe, this is fun♪ I wouldn't mind if we just kept walking like this.
Don't we look great together？ More than lovers... We might even pass for husband and wife!
Hehe, want me to feed you？ Say 'aah'!
Eating together like this makes it so much more fun.
Hey... If we lived together, I wonder if it'd always feel like this... Just a thought.
Being able to enjoy our meals is really important if we're gonna be together long-term.
That's so cute~! Maybe I should get it...
Hmm, what should I do？ Is there anything you want？
Hehe, so many things, I can't make up my mind.
Should we get a souvenir for both of us...? ...Or maybe next time？
I wonder what would be nice for you~
Hey, could you pick something out for me？
In the future, maybe we'll go shopping like this every day...
Geez, when I'm with you, I end up spending too much. Make sure to stop me, okay？
Hey, hey! What was that called again？
Looks like there's a lot... Let's explore some more？
Wonder what kind of local specialties they have here？
Hehe, I wonder if we'll make it around everywhere...
Any other sights to see... Let's check.
Hey, you aren't leaving it all to me, are you？ You gotta do research too!
Walking through a new town together... It's so lovely.
Wait... Is this...？ Hey, which way should we go？
I could almost live here... Don't you think？
No one around knows us, so why not get a little more lovey-dovey？
I'd like to look around a little more. Okay with you？
I wonder what else there is around here.
Want to wander around a little more？
Wonder if there's anything fun the two of us could do？
Bored at all？ Want me to keep you company？
Such a lovely time... If only time would slow down.
That was so relaxing. ...Such a blissful time, huh.
Just walking together is sure to be fun.
If we keep walking, I bet we'll find something.
Shall we walk just a little more？
I actually like this view quite a bit.
Yep! If you want to chat, I'm all yours.
Even just walking like this, I feel like we know what the other's thinking.
It was so fun, but it's already over. Let's go for a walk again.
Hehe, looks fun! I'm sure we'll love it.
Hope it's not too crowded... I wonder what it's like.
Heard the word about this place？ I bet it'll be lots of fun, though.
Hehe, that was fun! Did you like it too？
Ah, so this is what it's like.
I'm glad I'm with you. Even if it's fun, being alone is just lonely.
I wonder who's more lovey-dovey, us or the other couples around us？
Things like this are really best enjoyed together, huh？
Hey, hey. Can we play more？ It was just so much fun.
Haah, so satisfied. I definitely want to come play again.
There's so much to see, I don't know where to look~
Maybe this area could use a little more nature, huh？
Hmm？ Did you find a good shop？
Oh, that shop over there. Doesn't it look nice？
Everyone looks so busy. Let's just take it easy.
Hmm... Hehe, I can't help looking all around.
Not many people right now. This is nice in its own way.
It's a little quiet... Are there not many people？
There's a lot of people. Looks pretty lively!
This area really is lively, isn't it？
The horizon... Can you see it clearly？
The breeze by the sea really feels so nice, doesn't it？
I wonder if we can smell the sea breeze...？
The sea really is pretty... Look.
The sea is so vast... Oh, I wasn't singing that, okay？
Can we spot any ships, I wonder...？
Hardly anyone's here... Feels like we have the sea all to ourselves.
Surprisingly few people. What a waste.
Sure are a lot of people. Well, it is the sea.
There's so many people. Hope the sea stays clean.
Maybe because we're by the water, but the air feels so refreshing.
The scenery reflected on the water is lovely too, isn't it？
Hey, wonder if there are any fish？
The air feels kind of damp...
Water has its own scent, doesn't it？
Oh... I think I just saw something splash.
Hardly anyone's here. Even though it's such a nice spot.
Not many people around. It's so quiet...
So many people... Humankind always gathers by the water. Hehe.
So many people. Everyone's gathering by the water.
The air is so fresh~... Come on, take a deep breath.
Being surrounded by nature like this really is lovely.
Mm... I just hope there aren't too many bugs.
I hope all this nature stays like this for a long time.
Being out in nature like this makes me feel young again~...
Yeah, hardly anyone here. ...It's so relaxing.
I'm glad there aren't many people. We can really soak in all this nature.
There's so many people. I guess everyone's craving a bit of nature.
It might've been even nicer if it were a little quieter.
Mm, you can't really see the view, can you？
It's kind of dark... You doing okay？
Not a lot of light here... Don't worry, I'm not scared.
It's so dark... It's a little spooky, honestly.
It's a bit dim around here...
I wonder if they dimmed the lights...
It's pretty dim... Not that I'm scared or anything.
It's a little dark. Here, come closer so I can see your face.
Hey, can I hold your hand？ I mean, since it's dark...
The sun is pretty strong today...
Mmm... I hope the UV rays aren't too bad.
Harsh sun is so bad for your skin... Being a girl is hard work, you know？
It's so bright and pretty around here.
What's with the colors...？ Maybe it's the lighting？
They really keep it bright in here, don't they...
Look, the lighting is all sparkly...
Ugh, the lights are a bit harsh in here...
It's not as big as I thought.
We could probably walk this whole place in no time.
Um... How far are we allowed to go, I wonder？
...It feels a little cramped in here, doesn't it？
Oh, it's pretty small inside, isn't it？
Huh, it's really not that big.
We could make a full lap around here in no time.
It's just a little tight in here, isn't it.
Mmm, feels a bit confining, doesn't it？
It's so wide open... You can see all the way around.
Mmh, it's so open and spacious. Feels nice.
Wonder how far we can go around here.
Mmm... It really feels so open and airy.
Feels like 'as far as the eye can see,' doesn't it？
Hehe. Checking it all out is gonna take some work.
It's nice and open here. Feels wonderful.
Even though we're inside, it feels really open.
Wanna take a walk all the way around？
Now then, where are you taking me today？
Wonder where we're off to for our date today.
All right, let the date begin~♪
Today's date is gonna be so much fun, I just know it.
Where are we heading now~？ Is it a secret？
I was really looking forward to our date today, you know.
Our date. Were you looking forward to it too？
Shall we get going？ Aaaand off we go!
If you take too long, I'm gonna leave you behind~
This place has great reviews! Did you look it up？
Ah, I wanted to come here♪ Good boy, good boy.
Lovely... Hehe, I really wanted to come here.
This place looks fun. Yep, yep, you pass!
Rumor has it this place is really popular lately. I kinda wanted to come see it.
Oh, nice! So this is where we're having our fun.
Here？ Yeah, let's hope it turns out fun!
Oh, there's a place like this too？ Wonder what it's like.
Hmm, haven't heard much about it, though. Wonder if it's fun.
Oh, here again？ Sure, works for me.
Here, huh... Come to think of it, we've been here before.
Hey, hey, where are we going next？
Ready to move？ Now then, where should we go...
Well then, shall we head to the next spot？
Well... shall we get moving around now？
Where are you gonna escort me next, I wonder？
Hey, hey, which way are we going？
Um... I wonder which way we should go.
Hmm, which one... I'll leave it to you!
Which way should we go this time？
Mmm, it's so hard to choose.
Now then, what should we do next？
Next is... hmm... hmm... Okay, pass!
Hey, can I choose which way to go？ Let's see... This way!
All right... Let's go that way, then.
Now then. I'll pick this time. Yep, let's go over there.
Wait, didn't we just go that way？ I don't mind, though.
Oh, going that way again？ Okaaay.
Phew, that was such a wonderful date. Thanks, all thanks to my boyfriend▼
Mmm, that was so fun♪ Next time will be even better... right？ Hehe.
Yep, today's date was so satisfying. Good boy.
Thanks to my hardworking boyfriend, we had such a wonderful date.
Phew... that was fun♪ We definitely have to go out again, okay？
Mmm... That was so nice, I'm still basking in the afterglow.
Thanks for today. Are you tired？ Ask me out again, okay？
Mmm, yeah, that was fun. Let's go on another date soon, okay？
My thoughts？ Yeah, I had fun.
That date just flew by, didn't it？ I'd love to do it again.
Huh... Wait, it's over already？ A longer date might've been nice, too.
Ah, the date's over already？ Mmm, that was fun, though♪
Yeah, that was fun. This length is just right for a date, isn't it？
We really had fun! Any more and I might've worn myself out.
I really like dates around this length. Not too short, not too long, you know？
Whew... We really played our hearts out! Did you get tired？
Date over~! We really had our fill of fun, didn't we？
Phew... Thanks for today. We packed so much in, that was lots of fun.
That was fun. We've been to that spot before though, so maybe somewhere else next time...？
Was today's date the same place as before？ No, just wondering.
●. I actually found a great date spot... Can you go right now？
Right now？ Aren't you impatient？ Sure, but give me a minute to get ready.
Awesome, got it. See you in a bit.
It's ●... I came up with a nice date plan. Up for it right now？
Yeah, sure! I actually have some free time. I'll get ready right away.
Lucky! See you in a bit. I'll be waiting.
Hello, Nene here. What's going on？
Hey, I found a great date spot and wanted to invite you. Are you free now？
Right now...？ Yeah, I can. I'll hurry and get ready.
Thanks, take your time. Talk to you soon.
Hey, I brought us lunch... Wanna have some？
I threw it together in a rush, though... Hope it turned out okay.
Oh, right. It was sudden, but I packed us lunch. What do you think？
Hehe. Hope it suits your taste.
Are you kidding？ Of course I'll love it!
Hehe. Guess what？ I packed us lunch. I'd be so happy if you ate some...？
Look at you getting all excited. You're so cute.
Haha. How could I not be？
